page0.text: Time to make a final choice.

page1.text:
It's clear who will win this battle.
No, it would be more accurate to say that it was decided long ago.
This conclusion was ordained from the moment I lost her.

page2.text:
"But Shirou, choosing to go after it is the most difficult path of all.
Please keep that in mind."

page3.text:
The girl who fought by your side and acted as your sword until the very end said that.
On the night you parted ways,
you promised her that you'd go on fighting by yourself to put a stop to the Shadow and this war.

page4.text:
You went through hell.
You survived it for a reason.
You're still alive for a reason.
You didn't miraculously survive while everyone else died.
They all gave up their lives so that one person might live.

page5.text:
You hated that.
To break that reality, you told yourself that you had to become a righteous hero who saves everyone.

page6.text:
You don't know what his tears meant.
He destroyed the Holy Grail, rejected what he'd been fighting for, and desperately dug through the rubble to find a survivor.
No matter what he was thinking, his tears saved you and showed you a new path.

page7.text:
It became a lonely path.
He showed you a dream as he walked ahead of you, and then he died.
"Good. That's a relief."
Kiritsugu Emiya took the sins he never atoned for to his grave.

page8.text:
He couldn't save anyone,
so he wanted you to become someone who could save others.

page9.text:
"If you are going to deny everything you are...
you will be judged for that sin."

page10.text:
...You know that.
You've spent your entire life trying to redeem yourself.
You've killed yourself for the last ten years, believing in that idea.
Your dead self just keeps nibbling away at your living self, like worms eating a corpse.

page11.text:
And this is the embodiment of your sin.
It's pointless to mourn a saint.
As long as Archer's arm is attached to you, it will devour you and force you to atone.
It will bring you a ghastly fate worse than death.

page12.text:
Yes.
Even if you were to lose your life that hangs by a thread, you will not simply die.
And yet, why...

page13.text: "You know as well as I do that you can only choose to save one person, not everyone."

page14.text:
For a long, long time that girl searched for her father with only vengeance in her heart.
When you asked her to move in with you, she smiled sadly.
She told you it wasn't possible.
The two of us cannot live long together.
And that's why...
